gaps.name: Mold Breaker
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:6780-6785 (Bulletproof: 'No marked ability ignores breakable'); 19 'Mold Breaker' assumptions in src/combat/turn.c, also tools/datagen/gen_closure.py

gaps.name: Zero to Hero

gaps.name: Natural Cure
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:9849-9857 (Regenerator's SwitchOut heal in dfi_switch_in); src/combat/turn.c:2509-2524 (status cure clearing toxic_stage and sleep_cant)

gaps.name: Gyaradosite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because the Mega ability, Mold Breaker, is unmarked. Gyarados's Intimidate and Moxie are marked. Once Mold Breaker is marked, only recordings and the mark remain. The real cost is Mold Breaker (L).

gaps.name: Gyarados-Mega
gaps.family: ability suppression by the attacker (Mold Breaker; no Teravolt/Turboblaze in the pool)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:998-1012 (breakable target abilities read by id, each says no Mold Breaker is marked); src/state/closure_member.c:287-305 (Mega ok iff the Mega forme's ability is marked)

Gyarados-, Ampharos- and Emboar-Mega share it (347 games).

gaps.name: Bitter Malice
gaps.family: plain data rows awaiting a recording
gaps.notes: The 100% Atk -1 secondary is modelled. C2 left it out because its only learners carry Illusion (the duplicate-name gap). Illusion has since been marked (I2), so re-check that gap, then recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Focus Energy
deps: paused Focus Energy branch (the lead covers it)
gaps.notes: A crit stage +2 volatile. The state is ready: tail focus_energy and POSITION_EXT_FOCUS_ENERGY exist, and the Psych Up and Baton Pass copies and Dragon Cheer's refusal already read them (turn.c:5020, 5053, 9691). Missing: the writer, the +2 in the crit ratio and the -start line. A paused branch exists.

gaps.notes: The request disables it when lastMove is Gigaton Hammer (dfi_last_move_id exists), plus the -hint path; the Champions Disable override does not stop a cantusetwice move (turn.c:4250 comment). gaps.name: Jet Punch
gaps.notes: Modelled +1 priority punch. Unmarked because its only learner Palafin has only Zero to Hero, which is unmarked (support_manifest.c:557); with 184 games the real cost is Zero to Hero (a forme change on switch-out).

gaps.name: High Jump Kick

gaps.family: crash damage (High Jump Kick, Axe Kick, Supercell Slam)
gaps.notes: onMoveFail: the user loses baseMaxhp/2 on a miss, Protect or immunity, then the Emergency Exit check; Reckless boosts crash moves (turn.c:1778: the generator refuses a crash move until Reckless has a clause). Needs the gravity-flag block (Gravity is supported) and a crash damage cause. 179 games.

gaps.name: Snipe Shot
gaps.notes: tracksTarget ignores Follow Me/Rage Powder/Lightning Rod redirection, exactly Stalwart's existing gate; a tracksTarget column bit OR'ed into it. Champions BP 85; critRatio 2 is a column. Cheap for 168 games.

gaps.name: Libero

gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:4387-4410 (dfi_soak: soak_type/type2 + TYPE_CHANGE event) and src/state/battle_internal.h:392 (tail ability_state)

Type-change storage exists from Soak, so the work is the PrepareHit placement and the exclusions (callsMove, bounced). 160 games, the largest here.

gaps.name: Greninjite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because the Mega ability, Protean, is unmarked (Greninja's Torrent is marked). After that, recordings and the mark. The real cost is Protean (M).

gaps.name: Greninja-Mega
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:7036 (Soak sets soak_type, a pure type); src/combat/forms/mega.h:27 (soak_type cleared at forme change); src/state/closure_member.c:287-305
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Protean. In Gen 9 it works once per switch-in (effectState.protean): on PrepareHit the user becomes the move's type, with -start typechange. TYPE_CHANGE and soak_type already exist; the once-per-entry flag needs a tail bit. Greninja's base forme also has Protean.

gaps.name: Pickpocket
gaps.notes: Hook onAfterMoveSecondary, which exists (Eject Button, Red Card). On a contact hit an itemless holder takes the attacker's item: Thief reversed. It needs the switch-flag tests, the Sticky Hold and Mega Stone refusals, and the speed order with the other AfterMoveSecondary holders. High value (136 games, 93 sole).

gaps.name: Ampharosite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Mold Breaker (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Ampharos's Static is marked. After that, recordings and the mark. The real cost is Mold Breaker (L).

gaps.name: Ampharos-Mega
gaps.family: ability suppression by the attacker (Mold Breaker; no Teravolt/Turboblaze in the pool)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:998-1012 (breakable target abilities read by id); src/state/closure_member.c:287-305

gaps.name: Kangaskhanite

gaps.name: Kangaskhan-Mega
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Parental Bond. Every single-target, non-multihit damaging move (not noparentalbond, charge or spread) hits twice; the second hit does x0.25 (Champions scripts.ts:208), and -hitcount appears only when the second hit lands (:548). Secondaries, recoil, drain, Sash and Sturdy then apply per hit, so it touches the hit loop in many places.

gaps.name: Payback
gaps.notes: Doubled unless the target switched in this turn or will still move (queue.willMove). dfi_will_move (turn.c:4767) exists; newlySwitched may need a flag. A paused branch exists; the lead covers it.

gaps.name: Supreme Overlord
gaps.engine_refs: src/state/battle_internal.h:298,392 (ability_state, reserved for 'Supreme Overlord 0-5'); src/combat/turn.c:1744-1752 (Last Respects: dfi_fainted_members, revival refusal)
gaps.notes: Hooks onStart (flow entry) and onBasePower priority 21 (bp_chain) both exist. min(totalFainted, 5) is fixed at entry into the reserved ability_state, and the multipliers 4506..6144 are non-dyadic, so the chain order matters. The -start fallenN [silent] line may need an event. 114 games, 50 sole.

gaps.name: Transform
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:6399 (Transform and Imposter unmarked, no engine state yet)
gaps.notes: transformInto copies species, types, stats, moves at 5 PP, boosts, crit volatiles and ability; decision 0028 fixed the public values but the engine has no state for it. 114 games, and Imposter shares the work.

gaps.name: Hex
gaps.notes: BP doubled when the target has a major status (Comatose is not in the pool). One BP branch like Assurance's (turn.c:1705). 112 games: cheap and valuable.

gaps.name: Magician
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:3371-3410 (dfi_thief: takeItem, Sticky Hold, Unburden, ITEM_START)
gaps.notes: Hook: onAfterMoveSecondarySelf (move_body, after secondaries). An itemless holder takes the first item it can take from the targets it hit, after speedSort(hitTargets), which draws on ties. It reuses Thief's take path; Mega stones, Sticky Hold and Unburden are covered there. 111 games.

gaps.name: Wish
gaps.notes: Slot condition storing half the user's max HP and its start turn, healing at residual order 4 of the next turn with '[wisher] name'; needs per-slot state and a new HEAL shape. Champions PP 5. 111 games.

gaps.name: Disguise
deps: Mimikyu-Busted forme data (pool has DFI_FORME_MIMIKYU only)
permanent forme change keeping the ability (data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:105)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onDamage (priority 1), onCriticalHit, onEffectiveness and onUpdate. A move's damage becomes 0, with no crit and no effectiveness lines. Then, at Update, a permanent forme change to Busted and baseMaxhp/8 self-damage. It needs a busted state, a new forme row, and checks across multi-hit, Substitute and spread moves. 107 games.

gaps.name: Drampanite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Berserk (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Drampa's Cloud Nine is marked (G79). After that, recordings and the mark. The real cost is Berserk (M).

gaps.name: Drampa-Mega
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:2941-2951 (Emergency Exit half-HP test); src/combat/turn.c:3824-3830 (Sitrus in dfi_update); src/state/closure_member.c:287-305

Its onTryEatItem holds Sitrus or Oran back until after the boost, which affects ordering in dfi_update.

gaps.name: Imposter
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:6399 ('Transform and Imposter: unmarked, no engine state yet')
gaps.notes: Hook: onSwitchIn (flow). It transforms into the foe opposite (the mirrored slot). transformInto copies species, stats, boosts, moves with 5 PP, types and ability; the engine has none of this state. 101 games, one of the costliest.

gaps.name: Own Tempo
gaps.family: volatile immunity (Own Tempo, Oblivious, Inner Focus)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:968-985 (intimidate_guard list); src/combat/turn.c:2792-2811 and 2821-2845 (confusion add paths); src/combat/turn.c:10171-10190 (Update refusals for copied abilities)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onTryBoost for Intimidate (exists: add it to intimidate_guard); onTryAddVolatile for confusion (secondary, primary with -immune via onHit, and the lock-end fatigue confusion); onUpdate only via Trace and Skill Swap (refuse it like Limber). Three small sites. 99 games, 31 sole.

gaps.name: Pollen Puff
gaps.family: ally heal targeting (Milk Drink, Pollen Puff)
gaps.notes: Against a foe a 90 BP hit; against the ally BP 0 and a heal of floor(baseMaxhp/2), refused by Heal Block (cant). Heal Pulse's heal (turn.c:5763) plus an ally branch before the damage. 95 games.

gaps.name: Instruct
gaps.notes: The target reuses its last move at once with its lastMoveTargetLoc (prioritizeAction); long exclusion list (failinstruct, charge, recharge, Focus Punch volatile, 0 PP). Needs last-target state and a nested move action; Quash (turn.c:5717) only reorders. 93 games. Must add the `cant|X|nopp` line with it: turn.c:7567-7570 stops a move that has 0 PP when it runs but emits no line today (unreachable with marked moves; this move makes it reachable; pin sim/battle-actions.ts:282-283; section 11).

gaps.name: Quick Claw
gaps.notes: randomChance(1,5) is drawn once per move action at resolveAction (choice commit) when the move's priority is 0 or lower, with -activate|item: Quick Claw. Needs a fractional key in the queue sort and a new draw site at choice resolution. No Champions override.

gaps.name: Water Shuriken
gaps.family: multihit 2-5 (Icicle Spear, Rock Blast, Tail Slap, Bullet Seed, Water Shuriken)
gaps.notes: 2-5 hits at priority +1; the basePowerCallback only matters for Greninja-Ash, which is not in the pool (only Greninja and Greninja-Mega), so the generator only has to pin the callback as inert. 88 games, cheaper than its hand-work class.

gaps.name: Pain Split
gaps.notes: Sets both HPs to the floored average (-sethp lines, the target's [silent]). Simple maths, but -sethp is not a public event yet; Endeavor (turn.c:1520) deals damage instead. 87 games.

gaps.name: Worry Seed
deps: ability set by move (Skill Swap helpers)
gaps.family: ability set by move (Skill Swap, Role Play, Simple Beam, Worry Seed)
gaps.notes: Sets the target's ability to Insomnia (fails into Truant/Insomnia before accuracy) and cures its sleep; Insomnia is in the pool but unmarked, so its sleep immunity must come too. 84 games.

gaps.name: Leppa Berry
gaps.notes: Eaten when any move slot reaches 0 PP. It restores 10 PP to the first empty slot (or else the first slot that is not full), shown as -activate|item: Leppa Berry|move|[consumed]. Needs a new dfi_update bearer that reads member PP; Champions PP values matter.

gaps.name: Metal Burst
gaps.family: damage reflection (Counter, Mirror Coat, Metal Burst)
gaps.notes: Returns 1.5x the last damage taken this turn to that attacker's slot (getLastDamagedBy, target scripted). The engine keeps only a HURT bit (turn.c:2211), not the amount or the source. A paused branch exists; the lead covers it.

gaps.name: Golurkite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Unseen Fist (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Golurk's Iron Fist and No Guard are marked. Unseen Fist is cheap (S), so this whole pair is cheap.

gaps.name: Golurk-Mega
gaps.notes: Champions replaces the base Unseen Fist (onModifyMove deletes the protect flag) with onHitProtect bypassProtect. That is the same code as Piercing Drill, so the x0.25 bypass damage, -ability and -zbroken (scripts.ts:297-304) apply. It needs one more ability id in the existing helper: much cheaper than its hand-work class suggests.

gaps.name: Mortal Spin
gaps.family: hazard/seed removal after hit (Rapid Spin, Mortal Spin)
gaps.notes: allAdjacentFoes, 100% poison, then onAfterHit removes Leech Seed, the four hazards and the partial trap from the user (not under Sheer Force). Leech Seed has no END event yet (duoforge.h LEECH_SEED comment). Same code as Rapid Spin.

gaps.name: Illuminate
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1013-1019 (Keen Eye TryBoost) and :5928-5931 (Keen Eye ignoreEvasion)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onTryBoost and onModifyMove. Its code is identical to Keen Eye (marked, step G51) apart from the name, so add an OR at the two Keen Eye checks and mark it. 75 games: the cheapest gap in this batch.

gaps.name: Chesto Berry
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:3783-3850 (dfi_update bearers, Sitrus/Lum); src/combat/turn.c:2491-2525 (dfi_lum_berry, dfi_lum_cure); src/combat/turn.c:2981,3013 (hardcoded isBerry lists)
gaps.notes: Cures sleep on Update/Eat. As the first member of its family it needs a family column (the status as param), isBerry added to the hardcoded berry lists (eaten flag, Bug Bite, Unnerve) and a dfi_update bearer. The other five status berries are then S.

gaps.name: Electromorphosis
deps: move:charge (the charge volatile is not modelled; DFI_MOVE_CHARGE has no handler in turn.c)
gaps.notes: Hook: onDamagingHit order 1 (move_body). It adds the charge volatile on every damaging hit. That volatile (Electric base power x2, -start Charge [from] ability, removed after the next Electric move) does not exist yet: a new volatile plus a public view bit. 73 games.

gaps.name: Mirror Coat
gaps.family: damage reflection (Counter, Mirror Coat, Metal Burst)
gaps.notes: A beforeTurnCallback volatile records the last special hit from a foe (2x damage and its slot) and redirects to that slot; priority -5. Needs a turn-start hook, damage amount and source tracking, and redirection. Counter (unmarked) has the same shape.

gaps.name: Last Resort
gaps.notes: onTry fails unless every other move slot has been used since the user came in (moveSlot.used). Needs a per-slot used bit cleared at switch-in. A paused branch exists; the lead covers it.

gaps.name: Shed Tail
gaps.family: pivot with volatile pass (Baton Pass, Shed Tail)
gaps.notes: Costs ceil(maxhp/2), puts a Substitute on the user ([from] move: Shed Tail) and pivots passing only the Substitute; decision 0032 refuses Shed Tail explicitly. 71 games.

gaps.name: Dry Skin
gaps.family: absorb ability (Volt Absorb, Earth Eater, Dry Skin) + weather residual (Rain Dish, Solar Power)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onTryHit (move_body), onSourceBasePower (damage) and onWeather (residual). Water heals 1/4 or gives -immune; Fire base power x1.25; rain heals 1/8 and sun costs 1/8. Each part copies an existing pattern, but it touches three core parts.

gaps.name: Earth Eater
gaps.family: absorb ability (Volt Absorb, Earth Eater, Dry Skin)
gaps.notes: Hook: onTryHit (move_body, existing hook). A clone of Volt Absorb for Ground: heal 1/4 or -immune. TryHit runs before the type-immunity loop, so the order already matches. One branch plus recordings.

gaps.name: Chesnaughtite
gaps.notes: Nothing blocks it any more: Chesnaught's Overgrow and Bulletproof and Chesnaught-Mega's Bulletproof are all marked (Bulletproof since G83), and no note gives a reason to leave it out. Only recordings and the mark remain.

gaps.name: Chilly Reception
deps: pivot switch flag for a status selfSwitch move
gaps.family: pivot status move (Parting Shot, Chilly Reception)
gaps.notes: Snowscape (an existing handler), then selfSwitch at a PIVOT. The -prepare line comes from BeforeMove priority 100 (before the paralysis and sleep cant), so no turn-start step is needed. The generator has no switch flag for it, and the pin must be checked for what happens when snow is already up.

gaps.name: Ice Body
gaps.family: weather residual heal (Rain Dish, Ice Body)
gaps.notes: Hook: onWeather (residual eachEvent). Heals 1/16 in snow. The hail immunity does nothing, since snow deals no damage. A clone of Rain Dish under Snow, joining the same eachEvent order. 68 games, cheap.

gaps.name: King's Rock
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:8782-8976 (SECONDARY draws, flinch secondary); src/combat/turn.c:1450 (Sheer Force strip)
gaps.notes: ModifyMove adds a 10% flinch secondary to damaging moves that have none. Each target gets its own SECONDARY draw; Sheer Force (marked) strips it; Serene Grace and Shield Dust interact.

gaps.name: Rest
deps: decision 0066 Rest path (source bit, point mass S=3)
gaps.family: self sleep / sleep counter (Rest, Sleep Talk, Snore)
gaps.notes: Self-sleep plus full heal ([silent] heal line, sim/battle.ts:2278-2280). Champions slp onStart still draws sample([2,3,3]) before Rest overwrites time=3; decision 0066 section 3b demands its own path (source bit, S=3) and its own decision.

gaps.name: Synthesis
gaps.notes: Heals 1/2, 0.667 in sun, 1/4 in rain/sand/snow through effectiveWeather (Mega Sol and Utility Umbrella readers); one handler shared with Moonlight and Morning Sun.

gaps.name: Sap Sipper
gaps.family: absorb ability (Water Absorb, Sap Sipper, Motor Drive)
gaps.notes: Hook onTryHit (priority 1), which exists: a Grass move gives Atk +1 or -immune. onAllyTryHitSide (an ally's Grass side move boosts the holder) has no hook; without a Grass side move in the pool this is S. 63 games, 21 sole.

gaps.name: Cud Chew
deps: berry re-eat path (singleEvent Eat outside the item)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:10929-10938 (Speed Boost/Moody residual entries, order 28 sub 2) and :2973 (dfi_use_item_core)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onEatItem plus onResidual (order 28, sub 2). It stores the berry it ate and a counter (new per-holder state), then eats the berry again a turn later: -activate, -enditem [eat], then the berry's effect runs without the item. The counter depends on queue.peek, and Bug Bite/Pluck are excluded.

gaps.name: Healer
gaps.family: residual status cure (Healer, Hydration, Shed Skin)
gaps.notes: Hook: onResidual (order 5, sub 3). Champions raises the chance to 1/2 (base 3/10) to cure the statused ally: -activate, then cure. It needs a new residual kind, which is a callback that draws (it joins tie groups), plus a draw site. 62 games.

gaps.name: Surge Surfer
gaps.family: Speed ability (weather Speed family, Quick Feet, Surge Surfer)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:430-434 (weather Speed abilities in dfi_speed_key); src/combat/field/weather.h:69-77
gaps.notes: Hook onModifySpe, which exists: x2 in Electric Terrain (b->terrain), the terrain twin of the weather Speed family. 62 games, 34 sole; cheap.

gaps.name: Fire Fang
gaps.family: status + flinch double secondary (Ice Fang, Fire Fang, Thunder Fang)
gaps.notes: Two secondaries (10% burn, 10% flinch): Ice Fang's handler with a burn. C2 left it out because this needs a new special id or a status parameter (support_manifest.c:582-584). Thunder Fang comes with it.

gaps.name: Stored Power
gaps.notes: Same basePowerCallback as Power Trip: a SPECIAL_P entry ('storedpower': POWER_TRIP) plus recordings. 62 games for a data step.

gaps.name: Normal Gem
gaps.notes: On TryPrimaryHit of a Normal move (not Status, not pledge) the item is used and adds a 1-turn gem volatile: BasePower x5325/4096 at priority 14. The enditem line comes before the hit, Unburden triggers, and an -ate ability makes the move non-Normal first.

gaps.name: Topsy-Turvy
gaps.notes: Inverts every nonzero stage of the target with one -invertboost line; the mechanic is tiny, but it needs a new public event like CLEAR_ALL_BOOSTS (Haze). 60 games.

gaps.name: Fur Coat
gaps.family: defense stat modifier (Marvel Scale, Fur Coat, Grass Pelt)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1655-1657 (Marvel Scale in the defense chain)
gaps.notes: Hook: onModifyDef (damage). Def x2, a dyadic factor, so order does not matter. One chain member next to Marvel Scale plus recordings. 59 games, a cheap win.

gaps.name: Insomnia
gaps.family: status refusal ability (Limber, Thermal Exchange, Immunity, Insomnia)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onSetStatus, onTryAddVolatile (yawn) and onUpdate. It refuses sleep like Limber and refuses Yawn (-immune) like Leaf Guard. Check Rest's failure line if Rest is in the pool. 59 games, cheap.

gaps.name: Shelter
deps: converter fix: Goodra-Hisui switch id (tools/reference/trace_to_c.py swap_partners)
gaps.notes: Modelled (def +2 self). Unmarked because its only learner Goodra-Hisui cannot be recorded: the converter keys Goodra vs Goodra-Hisui (support_manifest.c:559-561, decision 0015 5co). Tool fix plus recordings.

gaps.name: Steely Spirit
gaps.family: base power ability (Iron Fist, Strong Jaw, Steely Spirit)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1761-1784 (bp_chain: Technician 30, Rivalry 24, Iron Fist 23, Tough Claws 21)
gaps.notes: Hook onAllyBasePower (priority 22), which exists as the bp_chain: x1.5 for a Steel move of the holder or its ally (alliesAndSelf), placed between Iron Fist (23) and Tough Claws (21). 57 games, 23 sole.

gaps.name: Wandering Spirit
gaps.family: ability overwrite on contact (Mummy, Wandering Spirit)
gaps.notes: Hook onDamagingHit, which exists: a contact hit runs battle.skillSwap(source, target). G70's Skill Swap covers most of it, but the line's cause is the ability (not a move) and it runs mid-hit, also for a holder that faints. 57 games, 34 sole.

gaps.name: Rock Blast
gaps.family: multihit 2-5 (Icicle Spear, Rock Blast, Tail Slap, Bullet Seed, Water Shuriken)
gaps.notes: Only a gen_closure.py SPECIAL_P entry ('rockblast': MULTI_HIT_2_5) plus recordings; the Champions weighted count is already modelled. Bullet flag is a column; Skill Link is unmarked so it never meets it.

gaps.name: Eelektrossite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Eelevate (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Eelektross's Levitate is marked. After that, recordings and the mark. The real cost is Eelevate (M).

gaps.name: Eelektross-Mega
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/field/terrain.h:23 (dfi_grounded, Levitate); src/combat/turn.c:6855-6861 (Ground immunity); src/combat/turn.c:4027-4038 (dfi_after_faint, Moxie)
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Eelevate, a Champions-only ability (the mod clears isNonstandard). It makes the holder airborne like Levitate and, after a Move KO, raises its best stat (getBestStat) by the KO count; it is breakable. Needs a best-stat helper and the Levitate checks extended.

gaps.name: Corrosion
gaps.notes: No hook: it is a source check in setStatus. When the source has Corrosion, psn/tox skips the Steel/Poison type immunity. This is one condition in dfi_try_status (a turn.c helper used by move_body). Synchronize sending poison back is the one interaction to record.

gaps.name: Magic Powder
gaps.notes: Sets the target to pure Psychic (-start typechange) and fails if it already is; the powder flag is modelled (flags2 POWDER). dfi_soak (turn.c:4387) with the type as a parameter covers it. Only learner Hatterene, 52 games.

gaps.name: Water Absorb
gaps.family: absorb ability (Water Absorb, Sap Sipper, Motor Drive)
gaps.notes: Hook onTryHit, which exists: Volt Absorb with Water moves. One clause, with Heal Block and the full-HP -immune as already modelled. 51 games, 21 sole.

gaps.name: Mummy
gaps.family: ability overwrite on contact (Mummy, Wandering Spirit)
gaps.notes: Hook onDamagingHit, which exists: a contact hit sets the attacker's ability to Mummy (End of the old ability, then ability_now). The special line -activate|holder|ability: Mummy|attacker|[ability] Old may need a new event field, and the cantsuppress refusals are needed too.

gaps.name: No Retreat
gaps.family: trap volatile (Mean Look, Jaw Lock, Octolock, No Retreat, Ingrain)
gaps.notes: +1 to all five stats and a self-trap volatile; fails if already active, and gives no trap if already trapped. Its own volatile on top of the trap rule. Only learner Falinks, 50 games.

gaps.name: Round
gaps.notes: onTry pulls every other queued Round to the front (prioritizeAction) with sourceEffect 'round', which doubles its power; needs a per-action flag in the queue record and a damage branch. Doubles move (ladder 0.136).

gaps.name: Altarianite
gaps.notes: The recorded blocker is stale. G75 left the stone unmarked because Altaria's Natural Cure and Cloud Nine were unmarked, but Cloud Nine is marked since G79 and Pixilate (the Mega ability) is marked. Only recordings and the mark remain; the g75 test that expects 0 must be updated.

gaps.name: Octolock
gaps.family: trap volatile (Mean Look, Jaw Lock, Octolock, No Retreat, Ingrain)
gaps.notes: Legal in Champions (isNonstandard null). The volatile traps while the source is active and drops Def/SpD by 1 at residual order 14, with a silent end when the source leaves. Close to the partial trap (turn.c:7450, residual entry 25) but a separate volatile. Only learner Grapploct, 48 games.

gaps.name: Facade
gaps.family: conditional base power x2 (Barb Barrage, Facade, Assurance)
gaps.notes: x2 power when the user has a status other than sleep, and the Champions modifyDamage skips the burn halving for Facade. Two small edits in dfi_get_damage.

gaps.name: Gyro Ball
gaps.notes: BP = floor(25 * target getStat(spe) / user getStat(spe)) + 1, max 150 (stages, Scarf, paralysis, Tailwind; no Trick Room negation). dfi_speed_key (turn.c:394) computes this but negates under Trick Room, so it needs a getStat variant; otherwise one BP branch. 47 games.

gaps.name: Shell Bell
gaps.notes: Heals totalDamage/8 after the move unless the holder has a forceSwitchFlag. One handler next to Life Orb's.

gaps.name: Clear Smog
gaps.notes: A never-missing 50 BP hit, then -clearboost|target clears that target's boosts. Haze's code exists, but its event CLEAR_ALL_BOOSTS has no position, so a per-target clear event (or a position on it) is likely new.

gaps.name: Heracronite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Skill Link (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Heracross's Swarm and Moxie are marked. After that, recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Heracross-Mega
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Skill Link: variable multi-hit moves take the maximum hit count (no count draw) and multiaccuracy is dropped (Triple Axel, Population Bomb). Heracross's own variable multi-hit moves (Pin Missile, Rock Blast, Bullet Seed) are unmarked, so the gain is small until they are.

gaps.name: Bullet Seed
gaps.family: random multi-hit 2-5 (Icicle Spear, Bone Rush, Bullet Seed)
gaps.notes: Same as Bone Rush: map multihit [2,5] to MULTI_HIT_2_5 in the generator. The bullet flag (Bulletproof) is already in the static flags. Recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Moonlight
gaps.notes: Heals 1/2, 0.667 in sun, 1/4 in rain, sand or snow (this.modify rounding), -fail at full HP. The heal-fraction path (turn.c:5564) plus a weather factor; no Champions override.

gaps.name: Air Cutter
gaps.family: plain data rows awaiting a recording
gaps.notes: Spread (allAdjacentFoes) Flying special 60/95 with crit ratio 2 and slicing. Every part is an existing column; C2 marked the same crit-2 shape. It is unmarked only because no batch recorded it, so it needs recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Barb Barrage
gaps.family: conditional base power x2 (Barb Barrage, Facade, Assurance)
gaps.notes: onBasePower does chainModify(2) when the target is poisoned or badly poisoned; the 50% poison secondary is data. It is one small special next to Assurance and Lash Out, plus recordings.

gaps.name: Aroma Veil
gaps.family: side-wide volatile/status veil (Flower Veil, Aroma Veil)
gaps.notes: Hook: onAllyTryAddVolatile (move_body). Blocks Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt and Torment on the holder and its ally. It shows a -block line only when a move caused it, so Cursed Body's Disable is blocked silently. It needs a check at each of the five volatile starters, and the -block line may need its own event shape (Flower Veil uses ACTIVATE).

gaps.name: Heatproof
gaps.family: type damage reducer at the target (Thick Fat, Water Bubble, Heatproof)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1921-1923 (Thick Fat in the attack chain) and :11261-11266 (burn residual damage)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onSourceModifyAtk/SpA (damage) and onDamage for brn (residual). Fire x0.5 copies Thick Fat; burn damage is halved (return damage/2, so check the truncation and the minimum 1 in spreadDamage). Two small edits.

gaps.name: Victreebelite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Innards Out (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Victreebel's Chlorophyll is marked. After that, recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Victreebel-Mega
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Innards Out: when the holder faints from a damaging hit, the attacker takes damage equal to the damage dealt (DamagingHitOrder 1). Needs a handler for a fainted holder and the right faint order in the hit loop.

gaps.name: Horn Leech
gaps.notes: Fully modelled (75 BP, drain 1/2). Unmarked because Gogoat and Trevenant had no marked ability (support_manifest.c:584); Frisk is marked since G81 (support_manifest.c:765), so a Trevenant can now carry it: recordings + mark.

gaps.name: Raging Bull
gaps.family: screen break (Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, Raging Bull)
gaps.notes: Breaks the target side's screens like Brick Break (dfi_break_screens), and its type follows the Tauros-Paldea forme (Fighting, Fire, Water); the three Paldea formes are in the pool. One handler built from existing parts. 40 games.

gaps.name: Vital Spirit
gaps.family: status immunity (Leaf Guard, Purifying Salt, Vital Spirit)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:2391-2405 (Leaf Guard onSetStatus); src/combat/turn.c:5328-5340 (Yawn); src/combat/turn.c:10171-10190 (Update refusals)
gaps.notes: Hooks onSetStatus (slp), onTryAddVolatile (yawn) and onUpdate all exist: Leaf Guard's shape for sleep only, with no sun test. onUpdate (cure sleep) matters only via Trace and Skill Swap, so refuse it like Limber. 39 games, 29 sole.

gaps.name: Endure
gaps.notes: A stall-counter move (Protect's dfi_run_protect) whose one-turn volatile keeps the user at 1 HP against a move's damage, with -activate|move: Endure. Focus Sash and Sturdy are the damage-clamp templates. It needs a one-turn bit.

gaps.name: Future Sight
gaps.notes: Slot condition futuremove: the slot is hit two turns later in the residual, damage computed then from the stored source. New slot state, residual entry and start/end events; Destiny Bond already excludes futuremove (support_manifest.c:550-551). Healing Wish (turn.c:6109) is the only slot-state precedent.

gaps.name: Pin Missile
gaps.family: multi-hit 2-5 (Icicle Spear, Bullet Seed, Rock Blast)
gaps.notes: Plain multihit [2, 5] with the Champions weighted count; it needs only the MULTI_HIT_2_5 generator mapping (gen_closure.py:2461) and recordings. Bullet Seed and Rock Blast are the same gap.

gaps.name: Poison Point
gaps.family: contact status ability (Static, Flame Body, Poison Point)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:4588-4600 (dfi_static); src/combat/turn.c:9100-9116 and 9172-9208 (DamagingHit calls, a fainted holder included)
gaps.notes: Hook onDamagingHit, which exists. A clone of Static and Flame Body with psn: randomChance(3,10), then trySetStatus. It needs a new DFI_SITE_* draw site (a fixture-stable id, src/rng/draw.h) and two call sites. 35 games, 17 sole.

gaps.name: Triple Arrows
gaps.family: double secondary (Ice Fang shape, boost + flinch)
gaps.notes: Two secondaries, def -1 at 50 then flinch at 30, critRatio 2; a two-roll loop like Ice Fang but with a boost secondary (Shield Dust, Sheer Force, Covert Cloak interplay).

gaps.name: Entrainment
gaps.family: ability transfer (Skill Swap, Entrainment, Role Play)
gaps.notes: The target's ability becomes the user's: Skill Swap's one-way half (the ability events, Start and End). onTryHit refuses the same ability, cantsuppress, Truant and noentrain sources. Reflectable.

gaps.name: Salt Cure
gaps.family: residual damage volatile (Salt Cure, Syrup Bomb)
gaps.notes: New volatile with -start/-end and residual order 13; Champions halves it (1/8 Water/Steel, else 1/16). Same order as the partial trap, so new residual ties to handle.

gaps.name: Whirlpool
gaps.family: partial trap (Bind, Wrap, Fire Spin, Sand Tomb, Infestation, Snap Trap, Whirlpool)
gaps.notes: Same partiallytrapped volatile; the classifier's id reference is only the team validator. Dive's doubled damage matters once Dive is marked. SPECIAL_P entry plus recordings.

gaps.name: Berserk
deps: HP-threshold after-move hook (as Emergency Exit's hp_before)
gaps.family: half-HP threshold after a move (Emergency Exit, Berserk, Anger Shell)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:2938-2955 (dfi_exits / dfi_emergency_exit threshold) and :3824-3829 (Sitrus at Update)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onAfterMoveSecondary (move_body) and onTryEatItem (flow, Update). SpA +1 when a move takes the holder from above half HP to half or less. In Champions the checkedBerserk flag ignores Sheer Force (mod :8-13), and while it is false the holder's Sitrus Berry waits until after the boost, which changes Sitrus timing inside the hit loop.

gaps.name: Early Bird
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:4196-4205 (dfi_before_move refuses Early Bird explicitly, decision 0066)
gaps.notes: Hook: slp's onBeforeMove (flow, dfi_before_move). The sleep counter goes down twice per attempt. The engine already refuses it on purpose: with the counted sleep_cant model it has 'no counted posterior', so this is a sleep-model extension (and the search posterior), not a one-liner.

gaps.name: Harvest
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:10929-10938 (residual entries order 28 sub 2) and :2973-2980 (dfi_use_item_core sets item_consumed)
gaps.notes: Hook: onResidual (order 28, sub 2). In sun, or with a 1/2 chance (a draw), it restores the last berry it ate: -item [from] ability: Harvest. Restoring could clear item_consumed, but lastItem is not the same as the sheet item after Trick or Knock Off. It also needs a new residual kind and draw site.

gaps.name: Bulldoze
gaps.notes: Classed modelled-unmarked, but it is not fully modelled: the Grassy Terrain halving at turn.c:1844 checks only EARTHQUAKE, while the pin's weakenedMoves includes bulldoze. It needs a one-line damage change plus recordings; allAdjacent and the 100% Spe -1 are existing paths.

gaps.name: Decorate
gaps.family: primary target boosts (Charm, Howl, Cotton Spore)
gaps.notes: Atk +2 and SpA +2 to one target through BOOST_ROLE_PRIMARY_TARGET (Charm's path). It has no protect flag (it passes Protect), is not reflectable, and is usually aimed at the ally. Recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Purifying Salt
gaps.family: status immunity (Leaf Guard, Purifying Salt, Vital Spirit)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:2391-2405 (Leaf Guard onSetStatus); src/combat/turn.c:5328-5340 (Leaf Guard and Yawn); src/combat/turn.c:1915-1922 (Thick Fat x0.5)
gaps.notes: Hooks onSetStatus, onTryAddVolatile (yawn) and onSourceModifyAtk/SpA all exist. It is Leaf Guard without the sun test, plus Thick Fat's dyadic x0.5 for Ghost moves, and it needs the same Flower Veil order refusal. 32 games.

gaps.name: Burning Jealousy
gaps.notes: A 100% secondary that burns a foe whose stats rose this turn. It is Alluring Voice's path (the STATS_RAISED flag, PUBLIC_CAUSE_RAISED_THIS_TURN) with a burn instead of confusion, on a spread allAdjacentFoes move. Only a new special id is needed.

gaps.name: Self-Destruct
deps: ability:damp rule (marked, no turn.c reader yet)
gaps.notes: selfdestruct 'always': the user faints after TryMove and before the allAdjacent hits (ally included), even on a miss; Damp's AnyTryMove cant must be added. Explosion shares it.

gaps.name: Heat Crash
gaps.notes: basePowerCallback and the Dynamax onTryHit are identical to Heavy Slam's, so the generator can map it to DFI_SPECIAL_HEAVY_SLAM; its minimize flag is inert while Minimize is unmarked. Recordings + mark.

gaps.name: Zoom Lens
gaps.family: accuracy modifier item (Wide Lens, Zoom Lens)
gaps.notes: Accuracy x4915/4096 when the target will not move again this turn (queue.willMove). dfi_will_move already exists; chain priority -2.

gaps.name: Fling
gaps.family: item use by move (Fling, Bug Bite, Natural Gift)
gaps.notes: The power and effect come from the held item: the fling BP, status orbs, berries the target eats, Mental Herb and White Herb effects. A volatile's Update then removes the item. It needs a new per-item column and many item interactions.

gaps.name: Screen Cleaner
gaps.notes: Hook onStart, which exists (entry ability): Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil are removed from both sides, with one -activate and then the side-end lines in side order. A new handler plus a dfi_has_entry entry; the removal itself belongs in side_conditions. 28 games.

gaps.name: Milk Drink
deps: an ability of Gogoat marked (Sap Sipper or Grass Pelt)
gaps.family: ally heal targeting (Milk Drink, Pollen Puff)
gaps.notes: Champions changes the target to adjacentAllyOrSelf (heals 1/2 to the user or its ally). The request and target resolution already know the class (request.c:62, turn.c:4800); dfi_move_targets and the heal-fraction path need the ally target. Only learner Gogoat has no marked ability.

gaps.name: Grassy Terrain
gaps.notes: Grassy Terrain itself (heal, Grass boost, Earthquake halving, Terrain Extender) is modelled via Grassy Surge; only the move setter is missing: a GRASSY_TERRAIN special added to the existing terrain-move dispatch (one new call, pattern of gen_closure.py:2512) plus recordings.

gaps.name: Grass Pelt
gaps.family: defense stat modifier (Marvel Scale, Fur Coat, Grass Pelt)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1655-1657 (Marvel Scale in the defense chain)
gaps.notes: Hook: onModifyDef (damage). Def x1.5 under Grassy Terrain (field.isTerrain, no grounding test). One chain member.

gaps.name: Growth
gaps.notes: Self +1 Atk/SpA, +2 each in sun (effectiveWeather; Utility Umbrella is not in the pool). Champions changes the type to Grass. One small handler on the existing self-boost path that reads the weather.

gaps.name: Supercell Slam
gaps.family: crash damage (High Jump Kick, Axe Kick, Supercell Slam)
gaps.notes: hasCrashDamage: half max HP on a miss, immunity or Protect (onMoveFail), nothing on a hit; Steel Beam's MoveFail site is the model. Shares a handler with High Jump Kick and Axe Kick.

gaps.name: Burn Up
gaps.family: type-loss self move (Double Shock, Burn Up)
gaps.notes: It fails unless the user is Fire type; then the user's Fire type becomes ??? (a typechange line). This is Double Shock's handler (decision 0025) for Fire. Champions: the mod sets isNonstandard null, and Burn Up does not thaw a frozen non-Fire user.

gaps.name: Explosion
deps: Damp rule (Damp is marked but inert)
gaps.notes: The user faints before the hits (selfdestruct always); allAdjacent, 250 BP. Damp is marked as inert (support_manifest.c:723) and must start blocking it (onAnyTryMove, data/abilities.ts:811-818: cant|holder|ability: Damp). The risk is the order of this faint against the targets' faints.

gaps.name: Guts
gaps.family: attack stat modifier (Huge Power, Guts, Hustle)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1915-1916 (Huge Power in the attack chain) and :2004 (burn halving)
gaps.notes: Hook: onModifyAtk (damage). Atk x1.5 while statused, and the Champions damage script skips the burn halving for Guts (scripts.ts:286). That is two lines in dfi_get_damage.

gaps.name: Seed Sower
gaps.family: field setter on hit (Sand Spit, Seed Sower)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:10111-10121 (terrain set and dfi_terrain_change in dfi_entry_ability); src/combat/turn.c:4503 (Toxic Debris)
gaps.notes: Hook onDamagingHit, which exists: every damaging hit sets Grassy Terrain. The inline terrain-set code must be factored out, and dfi_terrain_change (seeds) then runs in the middle of a move. 24 games.

gaps.name: Acupressure
gaps.notes: Picks a random stat below +6 on the user or its ally and gives it +2. dfi_move_targets has no adjacentAllyOrSelf branch (only dfi_resolve_target knows it, turn.c:4800), and the pick needs its own draw site, as Moody's sample has.

gaps.name: Avalanche
deps: per-source hurt-this-turn record (shared with Payback/Revenge-type turn history)
gaps.family: turn history: hit by this target this turn (Avalanche, Revenge, Comeuppance)
gaps.notes: Power x2 if the user took damage from that target this turn (attackedBy, thisTurn). HURT_THIS_TURN (battle_internal.h:317) is per target and has no source, so this needs a per-source record plus a PIVOT/view refusal like Assurance's. Priority -4.

gaps.name: Defog
gaps.family: hazard and screen removal (Defog, Rapid Spin, Tidy Up)
gaps.notes: Evasion -1 (not through a Substitute). It removes the target side's screens and hazards and the user side's hazards with -sideend [from] move: Defog [of] user, then clears the terrain (Ice Spinner's clear). Reflectable. The pieces exist; the -sideend cause and source may be new.

gaps.name: Fickle Beam
gaps.notes: randomChance(3,10) inside BasePower doubles the power with an -activate line and an [anim] attr. It needs its own draw site at the right point of the chain.

gaps.name: Tidy Up
gaps.family: hazard/substitute clear (Tidy Up, Rapid Spin, Defog)
gaps.notes: Removes every Substitute and all hazards on both sides (-sideend each), -activate if any, then atk/spe +1; succeeds if either happened. The events exist.

gaps.name: Metronome
gaps.notes: A volatile holds lastMove and numConsecutive, which needs moveLastTurnResult and two-turn handling. ModifyDamage is x(1+0.2n), up to 2x. The counter is new tail state.

gaps.name: Stockpile
gaps.notes: Volatile of 1-3 layers that tracks which def/spd boosts landed, shown as -start stockpileN and reverted on end; new state and volatile value.

gaps.name: Focus Punch
gaps.notes: priorityChargeCallback adds a 1-turn volatile at turn start (-singleturn); a damaging hit sets lostFocus and the move then shows cant|Focus Punch; the volatile also blocks flinch. Needs a new volatile, a turn-start hook and a cant cause; the HURT position flag (turn.c:2211) is set by any damage, not by onHit of a non-status move.

gaps.name: Counter
gaps.notes: A beforeTurnCallback volatile records the last physical hit by a foe (the slot, and twice the damage). The move has a scripted target, RedirectTarget and priority -5. It needs a new volatile, a turn-start hook and scripted targeting.

gaps.name: Dragon Rush
gaps.family: plain data rows awaiting a recording
gaps.notes: Dragon 100/75 with contact and a 20% flinch; its minimize flag is inert because Minimize is unmarked. Recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Infernal Parade
gaps.notes: Champions BP 65 (base 60), doubled against a statused target, 30% burn (modelled). Same branch as Hex.

gaps.name: Simple Beam
deps: ability set by move (Skill Swap helpers)
gaps.family: ability set by move (Skill Swap, Role Play, Simple Beam, Worry Seed)
gaps.notes: Sets the target's ability to Simple, which is not a pool ability (no DFI_ABILITY_SIMPLE): needs a new pool ability id plus Simple's doubled boosts in dfi_boost before the setAbility path is useful.

gaps.name: Gooey
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:9186-9190 (Weak Armor boost at DamagingHit) and :1055-1069 (Mirror Armor reflect)
gaps.notes: Hook: onDamagingHit (move_body, existing site). On contact: -ability Gooey, then the attacker's Speed -1 as a secondary boost (isSecondary true), which Clear Body, Mirror Armor and others can block. It also runs when the holder is knocked out. One branch.

gaps.name: Crabhammer
gaps.family: plain data rows awaiting a recording
gaps.notes: Water 100 with crit ratio 2; the Champions accuracy 95 is already in the row. All existing columns; unmarked for lack of a recording.

gaps.name: Thunder Fang
gaps.family: fang double secondary (Ice Fang, Thunder Fang, Fire Fang)
gaps.notes: Ice Fang's two-roll loop with par in place of frz; parametrise ICE_FANG's status (or a sibling special) and record.

gaps.name: Hunger Switch
deps: Morpeko-Hangry forme row (pool has DFI_FORME_MORPEKO only)
move:aurawheel (type follows the forme; no handler today)
gaps.family: temporary forme change (Stance Change, Hunger Switch)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/forms/stance_change.h:15-40 (forme_now temporary change, FORME event) and src/combat/turn.c:10929 (residual entries)
gaps.notes: Hook: onResidual (order 29, ability sub-order). Morpeko switches between Full Belly and Hangry every turn, with the Stance Change shape of forme change. The stats and types are the same, so alone it only changes a line; it matters together with Aura Wheel.

gaps.name: String Shot
gaps.notes: The generator refuses primary boosts on a spread class; the engine already runs PRIMARY_TARGET over several targets (Howl), so a generator branch for allAdjacentFoes plus recordings; check Magic Bounce on a spread reflectable move.

gaps.name: Heavy Metal
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1738 and :1743 (weight read straight from dfi_forme_of()->weight_hg)
gaps.notes: Hook: onModifyWeight. Weight x2. Today weight is read raw at two sites, so it needs a getWeight helper (Math.max(1, ...)) used by Low Kick, Grass Knot and Heavy Slam. Batch with Light Metal.

gaps.name: Quick Draw
deps: fractional priority in the action key
gaps.family: fractional priority (Quick Draw, Stall, Quick Claw)
gaps.notes: Hook onFractionalPriority does not exist. The roll is drawn once when the action is resolved (battle-queue.ts:249): a new draw site with an -activate line, and the action key needs a fractional tier between priority and speed. 18 games.

gaps.name: Audinite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Healer (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Audino's Regenerator is marked. After that, recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Light Ball
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1915 (Huge Power/Pure Power stat factor); src/data/pool_tables.h:60 (DFI_FORME_PIKACHU)
gaps.notes: Attack and Special Attack x2 for a Pikachu holder (ModifyAtk/SpA priority 1). It does nothing for other holders, but transfers by Trick or Knock Off must still work.

gaps.name: Audino-Mega
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:10940 (residual entry list, Leftovers order 5); src/combat/turn.c:2508-2525 (cureStatus in dfi_lum_cure); src/rng/draw.h:42 (draw site pattern)
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Healer. Champions uses randomChance(1,2) instead of the base 3/10, at residual order 5 sub-order 3. Needs a new residual entry and a new draw site for each statused adjacent ally, with -activate then -curestatus.

gaps.name: Aura Wheel
deps: forme Morpeko-Hangry (not in the pool tables)
gaps.notes: Only Morpeko learns it, and its only ability (Hunger Switch) is unmarked, so the move is unreachable until Hunger Switch and Morpeko-Hangry exist (the move is Dark when Hangry). The move itself is small: an onTry species check, the type by forme, and a 100% self Spe +1 (SECONDARY_SELF already exists).

gaps.name: Bite
gaps.family: plain data rows awaiting a recording
gaps.notes: Dark 60 with a 30% flinch and the bite flag (Strong Jaw is unmarked); all existing secondary columns. It is unmarked only for lack of a recorded battle: recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Minimize
gaps.notes: Evasion +2 plus a volatile: moves with the minimize flag (Body Slam, Heavy Slam, Heat Crash, ...) never miss and do double damage. New volatile with an accuracy and a damage hook; the minimize flags are already noted as inert (support_manifest.c:387).

gaps.name: Safeguard

gaps.name: Venoshock

gaps.name: Analytic

gaps.notes: Hook: onBasePower (damage). x5325/4096 when no other active Pokemon (ally included) still has a queued move. The willMove helper already exists, so this is one chain member; the only risk is queue entries the engine inserts late (Dancer-like, none marked).

gaps.name: Curious Medicine
gaps.family: entry ability acting on the ally (Hospitality, Curious Medicine)

gaps.name: Plus

gaps.name: White Smoke

gaps.name: Cross Chop
gaps.family: plain data rows awaiting a recording
gaps.notes: Fighting 100/80 with crit ratio 2 and contact; all existing columns. Recordings and the mark.

gaps.name: Smack Down
deps: groundedness readers (Levitate, Air Balloon, Iron Ball)
gaps.notes: Volatile that grounds a Flying/Levitate/Air Balloon target (-start only when it applies) and cancels Fly/Bounce; every groundedness reader must consult it.

gaps.name: Uproar
gaps.notes: Three-turn self lock (onLockMove) that wakes and keeps every active awake, residual 28.1 upkeep line; new volatile plus a sleep-block hook. Throat Chop or Struggle ends it.

gaps.name: Dive
deps: semi-invulnerable family generalised from Phantom Force
gaps.family: two-turn semi-invulnerable (Fly, Bounce, Dig, Dive, Phantom Force)
gaps.notes: Like Dig, but Surf (marked) hits the user for x2; no Sandstorm damage while it is under water. The Cramorant branch is dead in the pool (there is no Cramorant forme).

gaps.name: Eerie Spell
gaps.notes: A 100% secondary takes 3 PP from the target's last move, shown as -activate|target|move: Eerie Spell|MOVE|n. The tail's last_move slot (Encore) gives the move; the PP amount in the event and the view's PP knowledge need care. Sound and bypasssub. Must add the `cant|X|nopp` line with it: turn.c:7567-7570 stops a move that has 0 PP when it runs but emits no line today (unreachable with marked moves; this move makes it reachable; pin sim/battle-actions.ts:282-283; section 11).

gaps.name: Fell Stinger

gaps.name: Big Root
gaps.notes: TryHeal x5324/4096 for drain and Leech Seed heals (and Ingrain, Aqua Ring, Strength Sap once marked). Three heal paths, each with its own rounding.

gaps.name: Morning Sun
gaps.notes: Same onHit as Moonlight (Normal type); free once Moonlight is in.

gaps.name: Solar Blade

gaps.name: Emboarite

gaps.name: Emboar-Mega

gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:998-1012 (breakable target abilities read by id); src/state/closure_member.c:287-305
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Mold Breaker. Same work as mega:gyarados@gyaradosite.

gaps.name: Power Swap

gaps.name: Effect Spore
gaps.family: contact status retaliation (Static, Flame Body, Effect Spore)

gaps.notes: Hook: onDamagingHit (move_body, existing site). On contact, one random(100) roll: <11 sleep, <21 paralysis, <30 poison. It is skipped for powder-immune attackers (Grass, Overcoat, Safety Goggles). It needs a new draw site and uses the existing dfi_try_status. Sleep from an ability needs a recording.

gaps.name: Fluffy
gaps.family: target final-damage modifier (Multiscale, Solid Rock, Fluffy)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:2083 (Multiscale in the final modifier chain)
gaps.notes: Hook: onSourceModifyDamage (damage). Fire x2 and contact x0.5 in one chainModify, so a Fire contact move is x1. One chain member; the contact test should go through a contact helper if Long Reach lands.

gaps.name: Shell Side Arm
gaps.notes: onModifyMove compares a physical vs special estimate on the target's stats and draws randomChance(1,2) on a tie (a new draw site), then may turn Physical with contact. The 20% poison secondary is a column.

gaps.name: Copycat
gaps.notes: Uses the battle's last move (this.lastMove) through useMove. That needs a new battle-wide state field and the callsMove concept: a nested move run with the failcopycat filters.

gaps.name: Trick-or-Treat
gaps.family: type change by move (Soak, Reflect Type, Trick-or-Treat)
gaps.notes: Adds Ghost as a third (added) type with -start typeadd; every type reader (effectiveness, STAB, immunities) and the Curse retarget glitch must see it. Champions makes it legal.

gaps.name: Light Metal
gaps.notes: Hook: onModifyWeight. Weight trunc(/2), then max(1). Same helper as Heavy Metal.

gaps.name: Liquid Ooze
gaps.notes: Hook: onSourceTryHeal (drain, Leech Seed, Strength Sap). The heal becomes damage to the drainer, [from] ability: Liquid Ooze. There are four heal sites in two core parts, plus faint ordering when the ooze knocks the drainer out.

gaps.name: Focus Band
gaps.notes: randomChance(1,10) is drawn BEFORE the damage test, so a new draw site fires on every Move damage to the holder, including the confusion self-hit. On success the holder survives at 1 HP with -activate. The item is not consumed.

gaps.name: Charge
gaps.notes: SpD +1 and a volatile that doubles the next Electric move (BasePower priority 9); an Electric move, or its abort, removes it. The tail byte charge, POSITION_EXT_CHARGE and VIEWEXT_FEATURE_CHARGE already exist with no writer; a volatile id for the -start line may be new.

gaps.name: Electro Ball
gaps.family: stat-ratio base power (Electro Ball, Gyro Ball)
gaps.notes: BP is 40/60/80/120/150 by floor(user Spe / target Spe), using getStat: stages and ModifySpe (paralysis, Scarf, Tailwind, the weather abilities), without Trick Room. A small header next to weight_power.h would hold it, but the Speed value must match the pin's getStat, not the action key.

gaps.name: Rapid Spin
gaps.family: hazard/seed removal after hit (Rapid Spin, Mortal Spin)
gaps.notes: After the hit (not under Sheer Force) it removes Leech Seed, the four hazards and the partial trap from the user, then Speed +1. The hazards, Leech Seed and the partial trap exist; it needs the removal lines (a Leech Seed END is new) and the onAfterSubDamage variant.

gaps.name: Sleep Talk
gaps.family: self sleep / sleep counter (Rest, Sleep Talk, Snore)
gaps.notes: Runs after the cant line, draws sample() over eligible moves and useMove()s it; the engine has no move-calling path and decision 0066 refuses sleepUsable moves explicitly.

gaps.name: Sparkling Aria
gaps.notes: 100% secondary volatile, then onAfterMove cures the burn of hit targets (every target when it hit more than one, past Shield Dust); Sheer Force clears it. CURE_STATUS exists.

gaps.name: Stakeout
gaps.notes: Hook onModifyAtk/SpA, which exists (atk_chain): x2 (dyadic) while the defender's activeTurns is 0, read as the NEWLY_SWITCHED flag that Speed Boost uses. 10 games.

gaps.name: Sweet Veil
deps: ordering with Flower Veil and Leaf Guard
gaps.family: ally status guard (Flower Veil, Sweet Veil)
gaps.notes: Hooks onAllySetStatus (slp) and onAllyTryAddVolatile (yawn) exist as Flower Veil's side-wide shape: -block with [of] holder. The order against Flower Veil and Leaf Guard must be refused or modelled. 10 games.

gaps.name: Grav Apple
gaps.notes: Champions BP 90 (base 80), 100% Def -1 (modelled), onBasePower x1.5 while Gravity is up. Gravity is supported since K4 (tail.gravity_turns), so this is one entry in the base power chain like Grassy Terrain's (turn.c:1838).

gaps.name: Thrash
gaps.notes: Shares Outrage's LOCKED_MOVE handler; unmarked only for lack of a recorded battle (support_manifest.c:497-499, decision 0015 5aw). Recordings plus mark.

gaps.name: Supersweet Syrup
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:10127-10150 (Intimidate in dfi_entry_ability); src/state/battle_internal.h:344 (member_flags, bits 1-7 free)
gaps.notes: Hook onStart, which exists: Intimidate's shape with evasion -1 (a Substitute is -immune). It fires only once per battle per member (syrupTriggered), which needs a new member_flags bit. 9 games.

gaps.name: Sharpedonite
gaps.notes: The stone is unmarked only because Strong Jaw (the Mega ability) is unmarked; Sharpedo's Rough Skin and Speed Boost are marked. Decision 0015 defers it until there is a bite flag column.

gaps.name: Sharpedo-Mega
gaps.family: move-flag base power booster (Iron Fist, Mega Launcher, Strong Jaw)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1776 (BasePower chain); docs/decisions/0015-content-expansion-pool.md:649 (G83 bullet flag as a flags3 bit)
gaps.notes: The only blocker is Strong Jaw: x1.5 for bite moves. The pool has no bite flag, so a flags3 bit must be assigned first (as for bullet, G83); then it is one BasePower chain entry.

gaps.name: Merciless
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1554 (Super Luck in the crit ratio) and :1574 (Shell/Battle Armor)
gaps.notes: Hook: onModifyCritRatio (damage). It returns 5 against a psn/tox target, which sets the ratio rather than adding to it, so the crit is certain. Shell Armor still blocks. One line.

gaps.name: Sand Spit
gaps.family: field setter on hit (Sand Spit, Seed Sower)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:10097-10110 (weather set inline in dfi_entry_ability); src/combat/turn.c:4503-4520 (Toxic Debris: a field change from DamagingHit)
gaps.notes: Hook onDamagingHit, which exists: any damaging hit sets Sandstorm, also for a fainted holder. The weather-set code (rock extender, the -weather [from] ability line) is inline in dfi_entry_ability and must be factored out for this call.

gaps.name: Cotton Spore
gaps.family: primary target boosts (Charm, Howl, Cotton Spore)
gaps.notes: Spe -2 to both foes, powder. The engine already runs BOOST_ROLE_PRIMARY_TARGET over a spread list (Howl) and has the powder immunity; only the generator branch refuses allAdjacentFoes. A reflectable spread move with a Magic Bounce holder stays refused (turn.c:8278).

gaps.name: Role Play
deps: ability_now tail and Skill Swap helpers (decision 0041)
gaps.family: ability set by move (Skill Swap, Role Play, Simple Beam, Worry Seed)
gaps.notes: User takes the target's ability (setAbility with End/Start); the Skill Swap helpers cover set/End/Start, but the failroleplay/cantsuppress ability flags need a data column.

gaps.name: Gluttony
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:3824 (Sitrus at 1/2, no Gluttony test) and src/data/pool_tables.h:1193-1302 (the pool's berries: no 1/4 pinch berry)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onStart/onDamage, which only set a flag. Gluttony matters only for 1/4 pinch berries (Figy, Aguav, Liechi, ...), and none is in the pool, so it is inert today: mark plus recordings. Mark it inert the way Damp was.

gaps.name: Hustle
gaps.family: attack stat modifier (Huge Power, Guts, Hustle) + accuracy modifier (Compound Eyes)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1915-1916 (attack chain) and :5941 (Compound Eyes/Wide Lens accuracy)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onModifyAtk (damage) and onSourceModifyAccuracy (move_body accuracy). Atk is multiplied by this.modify, applied straight to the stat and rounded on its own, not chained (the pin comment). Physical accuracy x3277/4096. The rounding order is the trap.

gaps.name: Hydration
gaps.family: residual status cure (Healer, Hydration, Shed Skin)
gaps.notes: Hook: onResidual (order 5, sub 3). In rain (effectiveWeather) a statused holder shows -activate and is cured. No draw, but it needs a new residual kind that joins the sort at order 5.

gaps.name: Mimicry
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/field/terrain_seeds.h:56-75 (dfi_terrain_change: TerrainChange bearers) and src/combat/turn.c:4387 (dfi_soak type storage)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onStart (switch-in priority -1, tied with the seeds) and onTerrainChange (existing hook, moved area). The type becomes the terrain's, or reverts with -activate plus a silent -end typechange, which may need a new event. 7 games.

gaps.name: Ripen
gaps.notes: Hooks onTryHeal, onChangeBoost, onSourceModifyDamage, onTryEatItem and onEatItem: every berry effect is doubled, plus a berryWeaken flag (new state) for the resist berries. Many interactions across held items. 7 games.

gaps.name: Shield Dust
gaps.family: secondary suppression (Sheer Force, Shield Dust, Covert Cloak)
gaps.notes: Hook onModifySecondaries does not exist. The secondaries aimed at the holder are dropped (self effects stay), so that target gets no secondary draw. Every secondary site, and Poison Touch, must ask the target. 7 games.

gaps.name: Beak Blast
deps: priorityChargeCallback turn-start step (Beak Blast, Focus Punch, Shell Trap)
gaps.notes: Champions: BP 120, PP 5. At turn start, before any move, a one-turn volatile shows -singleturn; until the user moves, contact hits on it burn the attacker (Flame Body's burn path is close). It needs a new turn-start step in the flow plus a one-turn bit.

gaps.name: Mean Look
gaps.family: trap volatile (Mean Look, Jaw Lock, Octolock, No Retreat, Ingrain)
gaps.notes: Adds the trapped volatile with the source as trapper (ends when the source leaves). dfi_switch_trapped (turn.c:2907) knows only the partial trap and Shadow Tag; a stateful trapped volatile with source tracking and the Ghost exemption is new. Base of the trap family.

gaps.name: Night Daze
gaps.notes: Champions BP 90, 40% accuracy -1; modelled in C2. Held back because Zoroark's Illusion duplicate-name gap was open; decision 0026 (amended by I2) now refuses that case at the switch-in, so recordings + mark may be enough.

gaps.name: Snap Trap
gaps.family: partial trap (Bind, Wrap, Fire Spin, Sand Tomb, Infestation, Snap Trap, Whirlpool)
gaps.notes: Same partiallytrapped volatile as the five marked trappers: a SPECIAL_P entry plus recordings. Champions makes it legal and Steel-typed; dropped from G90 without a stated reason (decision 0060 section 8).

gaps.name: Wonder Room
gaps.notes: Five-turn pseudo weather that swaps Def and SpD in stat reads (and Body Press's offensive stat), ends on restart, residual 27.5; new field value and a stat-chain hook.

gaps.name: Forecast
deps: Castform-Sunny/Rainy/Snowy forme rows (pool has DFI_FORME_CASTFORM only)
a WeatherChange event at every weather start/end/suppression
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/forms/stance_change.h:15 (temporary forme change) and src/combat/turn.c:10102-10110 (weather set at entry)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onStart (switch-in priority -2) and onWeatherChange. Castform changes forme and type with the effective weather. The engine has no WeatherChange event, so every weather setter, weather end and Cloud Nine entry/exit would have to call it. 6 games.

gaps.name: Tangled Feet
gaps.family: evasion ability (Sand Veil, Snow Cloak, Tangled Feet)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:6930-6934 (Sand Veil's 3277 in the first-hit chain); src/combat/turn.c:5945-5949 (the later-hit refusal)
gaps.notes: Hook onModifyAccuracy (priority -1), which exists: x0.5 (dyadic) while the target is confused (confusion_turns). Copy Sand Veil's two sites. 6 games.

gaps.name: Shed Shell
deps: ability:runaway (same handlers in the Champions mod)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:2906-2928 (dfi_switch_trapped; its comment names Shed Shell and Run Away); src/state/request.c:273-277
gaps.notes: onTrapPokemon/onMaybeTrapPokemon clear trapped, so this is one early return in dfi_switch_trapped (outside the listed core parts). It frees the holder from both Shadow Tag and partial traps.

gaps.name: Attract
gaps.family: attract volatile (Cute Charm, Attract, Destiny Knot)
gaps.notes: The volatile, its BeforeMove roll and its end are on main (G71, decision 0034). The move adds the onTryImmunity gender check and reflectable/Magic Bounce. Its -start line has no [of], which decision 0080:36 says needs its own view and live rule first.

gaps.name: Fly

gaps.notes: Same as Bounce without the secondary: Thunder and Hurricane (marked) hit it, and Gravity bars and cancels it. Do Fly and Bounce together.

gaps.name: Gastro Acid
gaps.notes: Volatile that makes ignoringAbility() true: -endability plus the ability's End event, fails on cantsuppress abilities (Stance Change, Zero to Hero). The single ability read dfi_ability (current.h:46) is the natural hook, but every End handler and the view need care. Ability Shield is not in the pool.

gaps.name: Jaw Lock
gaps.family: trap volatile (Mean Look, Jaw Lock, Octolock, No Retreat, Ingrain)
gaps.notes: 80 BP bite that puts the trapped volatile on both user and target. Cheap once Mean Look's trapped volatile exists (dfi_switch_trapped, turn.c:2907, is the switch gate). Only learner Mabosstiff.

gaps.name: Raging Fury
gaps.notes: Same lockedmove self effect and randomNormal target as Outrage; it needs adding to the LOCKED_MOVE map (gen_closure.py:2395-2397, G56_LOCKED_MOVES) and recordings.

gaps.name: Cheek Pouch
deps: a common EatItem hook at every berry-eat site
gaps.notes: Hook: onEatItem. Heals baseMaxhp/3 after any berry is eaten. Berries are eaten at four sites today (Sitrus and Lum at Update, resist berries in damage, Bug Bite), so it needs one shared EatItem call after each Eat effect, with Heal Block and ordering against Symbiosis.

gaps.name: Motor Drive
gaps.family: absorb ability (Water Absorb, Sap Sipper, Motor Drive)
gaps.notes: Hook onTryHit, which exists (dfi_try_hit_abilities): an Electric move from another Pokemon gives Spe +1, or -immune at +6. It is Lightning Rod without the redirect, so one more clause.

gaps.name: Bounce
deps: semi-invulnerable family generalised from Phantom Force
gaps.family: two-turn semi-invulnerable (Fly, Bounce, Dig, Dive, Phantom Force)
gaps.notes: Phantom Force's charge exists, but dfi_semi_invulnerable hardcodes PHANTOMFORCE. Bounce adds its exceptions (the marked Thunder and Hurricane hit it), the Gravity bar and cancellation (Gravity is marked) and a 30% paralysis secondary. All of this work is shared with Fly.

gaps.name: Forest's Curse
gaps.notes: Adds Grass as a third type (-start typeadd). dfi_types_of (turn.c:140) has two type slots plus the Soak/Double Shock overrides; a third type touches every type read (effectiveness, STAB, immunities) and the view. Only learner Trevenant, 5 games.

gaps.name: Guard Swap
gaps.notes: Swaps Def/SpD stages between user and target with a -swapboost line. Psych Up's stage copy (turn.c:7092, COPY_BOOST event) is the closest; -swapboost has no public event yet.

gaps.name: Receiver
gaps.notes: Hook onAllyFaint in faint processing does not exist. The holder copies the fainted ally's ability (noreceiver list) like Trace: ability_now, the ABILITY event in the [from] ability: Receiver form, and the copied ability's Start. 4 games.

gaps.name: Skill Link
gaps.notes: Hook onModifyMove is not a hook here, but this is only a local test: 2-5 hit moves take 5 hits with no draw, and the multiaccuracy moves (Triple Axel, Population Bomb) check accuracy once. Two tests in the hit loop. 4 games.

gaps.name: Aqua Ring
gaps.family: self residual heal volatile (Aqua Ring, Ingrain)
gaps.notes: A volatile that heals 1/16 at residual order 6; Baton Pass copies it. It needs a new tail bit (position_flags is full, battle_internal.h:316-329), a public bit, a -start line, a residual kind and the Heal Block interaction.

gaps.name: Belch
deps: member ateBerry bit, set at every berry eaten (Bug Bite and Cud Chew included)
gaps.notes: Champions removes onDisableMove, so Belch is always selectable, and onTry fails it unless the user has eaten a berry. ateBerry is set once per member and lasts the whole battle (sim/pokemon.ts:1804). It needs one persistent member bit plus its view; the move itself is trivial.

gaps.name: Court Change
gaps.notes: Swaps every listed side condition between the two sides: Tailwind, the screens, Aurora Veil, the hazards with their layers and order, and the durations. A new event -swapsideconditions comes before the -activate line. It is mostly field code with one dispatch in the move body.

gaps.name: Meteor Beam
gaps.family: charge move (Electro Shot, Solar Beam, Phantom Force)
gaps.notes: Charge turn with -prepare and SpA +1 and no weather skip (only Power Herb's ChargeMove, not in the pool). It is Electro Shot without the rain skip: one more special in the charge_move list.

gaps.name: Misty Explosion
gaps.notes: selfdestruct always (the user faints even on a miss), allAdjacent, x1.5 BP in Misty Terrain for a grounded user; Damp (marked) must stop it. dfi_queue_self_faint (turn.c:1463, Final Gambit and Memento) is the faint path; Explosion and Self-Destruct are unmarked too.

gaps.name: Torment
gaps.notes: Volatile (-start/-end Torment, no duration) that disables the holder's last move at each request; needs a new volatile value and the request filter. Mental Herb (marked) cures it.

gaps.name: Immunity
gaps.family: status refusal ability (Limber, Thermal Exchange, Immunity, Insomnia)
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:2369-2377 (Limber in dfi_try_status) and :10052, :10177 (Trace/Skill Swap refusal for a statused holder)
gaps.notes: Hooks: onSetStatus (status setting) and onUpdate. It refuses psn/tox like Limber, including the Flower Veil order refusal. The onUpdate cure only matters after Trace or Skill Swap; add it to the existing refusals.

gaps.name: Opportunist
gaps.engine_refs: src/combat/turn.c:1035-1070 (TryBoost handlers in dfi_boost); src/combat/turn.c:10929-10937 (residual ability entries)
gaps.notes: Hooks onFoeAfterBoost (to accumulate) and onAnySwitchIn, AfterMega, AfterMove and onResidual (order 29) to apply the boosts; none of these hooks exist. It needs a stored boost table per holder (new state) and flush points across flow and residual. 3 games.

gaps.name: Dig
deps: semi-invulnerable family generalised from Phantom Force
gaps.family: two-turn semi-invulnerable (Fly, Bounce, Dig, Dive, Phantom Force)
gaps.notes: Phantom Force's two-turn charge plus Dig's own rules: Earthquake (marked) hits the user underground for x2, and it takes no Sandstorm damage there (residual). dfi_semi_invulnerable must take a per-move exception list.

gaps.name: Fairy Lock
gaps.family: trap volatile (Block, Mean Look, Fairy Lock)
gaps.notes: A pseudo-weather for 2 turns that traps every Pokemon (tryTrap; Ghost types are immune). It needs new field state, a -fieldactivate event, its duration in field/duration.h and the request refusal in dfi_switch_trapped.

gaps.name: Guard Split
gaps.family: stored-stat swap/average (Speed Swap, Power/Guard Split, Power Trick)
gaps.notes: Averages the stored Def and SpD of user and target, -activate with [of]. Same shape as Speed Swap (stored stats rewritten, presence bit, reset at switch-out, Mega, Stance Change) but needs its own volatile kind for the event and the view.

gaps.name: Power Split
gaps.family: stored-stat swap/average (Speed Swap, Power/Guard Split, Power Trick)
gaps.notes: Guard Split for Atk/SpA: same code and the same new volatile kind.

gaps.name: Recycle
gaps.notes: Restores lastItem (an item used or eaten, not one knocked off or stolen) with -item [from] move. The engine keeps no lastItem per member: new state set at every consume path (berries, Bug Bite eats, seeds, gems). The ITEM_START event exists.

gaps.name: Shift Gear
gaps.family: boost key order (Shell Smash, Shift Gear)
gaps.notes: Tables model it, but the pin applies spe +2 before atk +1 (key order) while the engine boosts in stat order (support_manifest.c:557-559); needs a small order flag like Shell Smash's, then recordings.

gaps.name: Sky Attack
gaps.family: two-turn charge (Solar Beam, Electro Shot, Phantom Force, Sky Attack)
gaps.notes: Plain two-turn charge without a weather skip and without semi-invulnerability; critRatio 2, 30% flinch and target any are columns. One new special and a charge_move case; Power Herb is unmarked.

gaps.name: Sweet Scent
gaps.notes: Evasion -2 to both foes; the same generator gap as String Shot. The evasion stage is already stored and read by the accuracy step.

gaps.name: Syrup Bomb
gaps.family: residual damage volatile (Salt Cure, Syrup Bomb)
